data.name: Florist Bar: Floristry Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Features:

The florist shop, Florist Bar, has finally finished renovations. But it seems not everything went to plan...

  • Take over the floristry shop, Florist Bar, and fulfil the duties of a florist.

  • Customers are going to come and order either a bouquet or a single flower. They may be specific, ask for particular colours, or ask for something around Flower Language.

  • At the end of, and throughout, the day you'll know how much the customers liked their orders.

  • You'll be able to buy flowers, foliage, furniture, and decorations to help decorate Florist Bar.

A Calming Work Environment

Open the shop for the day and lose yourself in the atmosphere of the street: the birdsong, the street ambience, and gentle piano music.

Customer Order Possibilities

When customers come to the counter, they could ask for a bouquet. They'll tell you what type of bouquet they'd like, and either mention specific flowers and foliage, ask for a colour combination, or they could ask for flower and foliage based on Flower Language.

Another option, customers could ask for, is a single flower. A small order, that could mean everything; with what it is specifically, its aesthetic appearance, or could mean everything with what it speaks in Flower Language.

Flower Language

A diary on Flower Language is beside the Bouquet pot. It contains information on each flower/foliage's different meanings, small facts, and details on their appearance.

Customer Satisfaction

After each order, the customer's face will tell you how much they like the order. At the end of the day, you'll be able to see what customers have to say about the order they received.

Shop Decoration, and Stock Improvement

With the money you've earned, you'll be able to furnish Florist Bar, decorate the shop, and buy more stock to make more varied + expensive orders.

data.short_description: A casual, cosy, simulator game, Florist Bar is about making bouquets or picking a flower to sell to customers. They may come in with a specific order, a specific colour combination, or for an order around flower language. Complete orders at your pace, in the cosy calm of a little florist shop.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 6000 series or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
